title: CondoGuard HO-6 Tier Line-Up and Entry Requirements
content:
The CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy is written in six tiers, ranked from 1 to 6. Each tier has its own entry requirements and its own peril and settlement basis for the unit's property.

## Entry requirements

A tier is open to a unit only when all of the following hold for that tier:

1. the unit is in a condominium association that carries a master policy;
2. the number of paid claims in the last 36 months is no more than the tier's maximum;
3. the unit's occupancy is one the tier accepts.

| Rank | Tier | Master policy required | Most paid claims in 36 months | Occupancies accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | yes | 1 | owner occupied, seasonal |
| 2 | CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | yes | 1 | owner occupied, seasonal, rented to others |
| 3 | CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | yes | 1 | owner occupied, seasonal, rented to others |
| 4 | CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | yes | 1 | owner occupied, seasonal, rented to others |
| 5 | CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | yes | 0 | owner occupied, seasonal, rented to others |
| 6 | CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | yes | 0 | owner occupied, seasonal, rented to others |

## Peril and settlement basis

Coverage A is the unit property (fixtures, improvements and betterments); Coverage C is personal property.

| Tier | Coverage A perils | Coverage C perils | Coverage C settlement |
|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | named perils | named perils | actual cash value |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | named perils | named perils | replacement cost |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | open perils | named perils | replacement cost |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | open perils | named perils | replacement cost |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | open perils | open perils | replacement cost |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | open perils | open perils | replacement cost |

## Reading the tables (illustrations with hypothetical applicants)

- An applicant with exactly 1 paid claim in the last 36 months meets the claims requirement of tiers 1 to 4 (maximum 1) and not that of tiers 5 and 6 (maximum 0).
- A unit rented to others meets the occupancy requirement of every tier except CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential.
- Only CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential settles Coverage C at actual cash value; the other five tiers settle Coverage C at replacement cost.
